topics.name: MeritCore Recency-Specific Competence Profile
topics.purpose: Define competence-specific recency requirements without introducing generic MeritCore time decay.

semantics.default_rule: MeritCore evidence has no generic time-decay.
semantics.profile_rule: A specific competence criterion may explicitly require recent evidence.
semantics.scope_rule: Recency applies only to the competence/Tier criterion that declares it.
semantics.history_rule: Older evidence remains historical evidence even when it no longer satisfies a specific recency criterion.
semantics.tier_rule: Tier effects follow exact competence policy rather than global decay.

invariants.rule: Identity, portfolio, merit, recommendation, trust and competence states derive only from explicit provenance-bearing evidence; display text, self-authored claims, ranking position or AI inference never become verified evidence by themselves.

Distinct canonical identities maintain independent evidence histories; merit, Tier, trust and recommendation histories are not mergeable across identities unless a future explicit canonical identity-merger contract exists.

hard_gates.condition: global merit decays yearly by default
one competence recency affects all Tiers

references.purpose: Tier consumes recency only where explicit competence policy requires it.
